usage: 每次只复制一个 positivePrompt 到工作流；固定种子并逐张验收身份一致性。生成结果是 Live2D 绘制参考，不可直接代替可绑定 PSD 图层。
globalLock: Preserve the exact identity, facial proportions, glasses, blue-to-lavender hair, outfit, body, front-facing neutral pose, framing, line art, and background. Change only the requested facial area. Keep facial skin clean with no white dots, nose highlights, or holographic particles.

expressions.label: 平静
expressions.positivePrompt: Change only the facial expression to calm neutral attentiveness: relaxed brows, open eyes, closed relaxed mouth. Preserve everything else exactly.

expressions.label: 温柔微笑
expressions.positivePrompt: Change only the facial expression to a gentle, warm closed-mouth smile with relaxed kind eyes. Preserve everything else exactly.

expressions.label: 开心
expressions.positivePrompt: Change only the facial expression to genuine happiness: softly closed smiling eyes, raised cheeks, small open smile. Preserve everything else exactly.

expressions.label: 担心
expressions.positivePrompt: Change only the facial expression to gentle concern: slightly raised inner brows, attentive eyes, small closed mouth. Do not make her frightened or distressed. Preserve everything else exactly.

expressions.label: 惊讶
expressions.positivePrompt: Change only the facial expression to mild friendly surprise: slightly widened eyes, raised brows, small round open mouth. Preserve everything else exactly.

expressions.label: 思考
expressions.positivePrompt: Change only the facial expression to thoughtful concentration: eyes looking slightly upward, one brow subtly raised, closed relaxed mouth. Keep the head and body facing forward. Preserve everything else exactly.

expressions.label: 害羞
expressions.positivePrompt: Change only the facial expression to gentle shyness: softened eyes, subtle warm blush, small closed smile. No sparkles or white dots on skin. Preserve everything else exactly.

eyes.label: 半闭眼
eyes.positivePrompt: Change only both eyelids to an exact symmetrical half-blink. Keep iris position, glasses, brows, mouth, and identity unchanged.

eyes.label: 闭眼
eyes.positivePrompt: Change only both eyes to fully closed relaxed anime eyelids, perfectly symmetrical. Keep glasses, brows, mouth, and identity unchanged.

mouthShapes.label: 闭口
mouthShapes.positivePrompt: Change only the mouth to a relaxed closed neutral mouth. Keep the eyes, brows, face, glasses, and identity unchanged.

mouthShapes.label: A/啊
mouthShapes.positivePrompt: Change only the mouth to the Japanese phoneme A: vertically open natural oval, jaw slightly lowered, tongue not prominent. Keep all other facial features unchanged.

mouthShapes.label: I/衣
mouthShapes.positivePrompt: Change only the mouth to the Japanese phoneme I: horizontally narrow opening with slightly spread corners. Keep all other facial features unchanged.

mouthShapes.label: U/乌
mouthShapes.positivePrompt: Change only the mouth to the Japanese phoneme U: small rounded pursed opening. Keep all other facial features unchanged.

mouthShapes.label: E/诶
mouthShapes.positivePrompt: Change only the mouth to the Japanese phoneme E: medium horizontal opening, relaxed corners. Keep all other facial features unchanged.

mouthShapes.label: O/哦
mouthShapes.positivePrompt: Change only the mouth to the Japanese phoneme O: clearly rounded medium oval opening. Keep all other facial features unchanged.
